newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Sierra Leone army holds ex-ministers after coup.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Leone army holds ex-ministers after coup.

text.p: Sierra Leone's new military rulers have arrested five ministers of the civilian government ousted in Sunday's coup and troops are searching for other former cabinet members, military sources said on Monday.
The sources said the five were being held at the military headquarters in the capital Freetown.
The sources said troops were carrying out house-to-house searches for the other ministers.
The coup leaders on Sunday night announced the formation of an Armed Forces Revolutionary Council led by Major Johnny Paul Koromah. Civilian president Ahmad Tejan Kabbah flew to neighbouring Guinea.
Staff at Freetown's main hospital said at least 15 people were killed in Sunday's fighting. Lebanese Foreign Minister Faris Bouez said the dead included two Lebanese.

The hospital sources said two Nigerian soldiers from the West African ECOMOG force had been killed in the fighting, but ECOMOG Field Commander General Victor Malu said in Lagos there had been no Nigerian casualties.
